summary: Round 14 (clean worktree at 2b2f46b, which includes e3e95f3). The aisle views are almost unchanged from w13 (q06 mean pixel diff 4.7/765), so the layout is still clearly the same product as c_27312 and c_27315. All five w13 medium issues moved. (1) The O comforter now covers the full width from the blue pillow to the table corner, with the pad showing at the head-aisle corner, which is the same topology as tpg_81 (o2, o7). (2) The buckle is now in view at the belt's front end (o1, r3). (3) The pillow check now runs in diagonal bands at lower contrast, close to kn_17 and tpg_81 (pillowcmp). The pillow is darker (r7 (124,138,216), was (143,157,220)). White-pillow ratios are r9 (0.52, 0.58, 0.88) against tpg_81 white-balanced (0.49, 0.54, 0.89), a match. (4) The ash door/cabinet split exists but is far too weak. In q06 the cabinet is 176 and the aisle post 183; c_27312 has 129 and 208. The pale door posts still carry the full streak gain (hp 0.072 against 0.028). (5) In the q07 seated view the grain is still smeared at grazing angles, although 01_gl.js now requests anisotropic filtering, most likely because SwiftShader lacks the extension. What still holds the area just below 8.5: tables and cabinets are too pale and low in contrast (q06 table (198,191,180), hp 0.041, against c_27312 (166,152,136), hp 0.106; tpg_81 table WB 0.88/0.83/0.77 of the white pillow against r9 0.96/0.95/0.92); the O bed's wide part is short (0.66 m against ~0.9 m in tpg_81, perspective-corrected); the pillows are stiff bevelled slabs; and the buckle is a small flat pale tab. Lighting (not scored): in the cabin views the pillow is over-saturated (q09) and the sofa fabric reads mauve (q10).

issues.detail: The ash door/cabinet split is too weak: cabinets and tables are too pale and low in contrast, and the pale door posts are too streaky
issues.problem: Both ash materials share LAYER.ashGrain at PHOTO_GAIN 2.3, and the two base colours are only ~8 % apart in the render. In ANA's photos the cabinets, back panels and table inlays are clearly darker, warmer greige with crisp streaks. The aisle-end doors are pale cream and nearly plain at aisle distance.
issues.fix: 09_seats.js (shared, one line): SEATMAT.ash '#c8bba7' -> '#b2a28b'. 03_tex.js (shared, one line each): LAYER ashDoor: 30, PHOTO_LAYERS[30] = 'j_ash', PHOTO_GAIN[30] = 1.0, N_LAYERS 30 -> 31, and copy LAYER_PARAMS[19] to [30]. 09c: ashDoor l: LAYER.ashDoor. Then raise PHOTO_GAIN[19] 2.3 -> 2.8, which affects only the cabinets and tables (check barAsh in 10_mono.js). Target q06: cabinet <= 150, post >= 195, post hp <= 0.04, table hp >= 0.07.

issues.detail: O bed wide part looks short against tpg_81 (proportion)
issues.problem: In the model the mattress is full width from the head (z -1.28) to the table corner (tz0 -0.62), 0.66 m. In tpg_81, using the blue pillow (0.44 m) as scale and correcting for the table top sitting ~0.2 m above the pad, the head-to-table-corner distance is ~0.9 m. The comforter's visible full-width area is therefore about half that of the photo.
issues.evidence: o2: head to table corner 90 px at 132 px/m, i.e. 0.68 m. tpg_81: white pillow head x ~170, table corner x ~1050 (bed level ~1010), at ~900 px/m, i.e. ~0.9 m.
issues.fix: Only if a seat-map dimension confirms it (see the question). Move O's table corner tz0 from -0.62 toward -0.45 together with the mattress split (mat z1 -0.62 -> -0.45, second mat z0 -0.64 -> -0.47) and the O bounds a = smooth(-0.51, -0.40). The E side table mirrors this (zT 0.62). This shortens the footwell mouth ledge, so check the upright seat's legroom against c_27316.

issues.detail: Buckle is a small flat pale tab; latch half not visible
issues.problem: kn_17 and c_27316 show a chunky polished lift-lever buckle (~7 x 4.5 cm) with a dark lever slot and strong specular. The model buckle is 5 x 3.5 x 1.2 cm, uniform (195,198,203), and reads as a strap-end tab. The latch half is hidden under the bundle.
issues.fix: 09c line ~68: buckle gRBox(0.05,0.012,0.035) -> gRBox(0.065, 0.014, 0.045, 0.006, 1), plus a lever plate gRBox(0.045, 0.003, 0.028, 0.002, 1) at +0.0085 y in SEATMAT.buckle with r 0.12, and a 0.03 x 0.002 x 0.004 black slot. Move the latch half to CU (-0.05, 0.048, -0.05) so it shows between the bundle and the belt.

issues.problem: The blue pillow has a crisp chamfered rim catching light all round (r7, pillowcmp). Real pillows (kn_17, tpg_81) are puffy, with pinched corner ears and soft creases.
issues.fix: As w13a: build roomPillow as a 36x24 grid with thickness T*(1-(2u-1)^4)*(1-(2v-1)^4)^0.6 + 0.004 and 2 low sine wrinkles (A 3 mm); keep the flange loft.

issues.detail: O comforter drape flat with a single hump at the T junction
issues.problem: tpg_81 shows 3-4 broad loose folds and fine crinkles. The model sheet is smooth, with one raised ridge where the wall band meets the wide part (o7 340-380 x 250-290).
In the cabin the pillow renders over-saturated (q09), the sofa fabric reads mauve (q10), and the shells read cool.
